sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glyph(frame,r0,c0):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('#' if a[r][c]=='B' else ('o' if a[r][c]=='P' else '.') for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def black(g): return tuple(x.replace('o','.') for x in g)
def cardglyph(r0,c0):
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('#' if a[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
cards={'P12':cardglyph(5,23),'P14':cardglyph(5,46),'P22':cardglyph(14,23),'P24':cardglyph(14,46),'P32':cardglyph(23,23),'P34':cardglyph(23,46)}
blue=[black(glyph(current_frame,41,15+7*i)) for i in range(5)]
# rebuild cycles by re-reading? Not stored. Re-map quickly (cursor at slot 4 after last snippet? verify)
def cursor_col(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    for r in range(58,62):
        for c in range(12,52):
            if a[r][c]=='W': return c
print('cursor col:',cursor_col(current_frame))
cycles={}
for slot in range(5):
    for _ in range(10):
        if cursor_col(current_frame)==15+7*slot: break
        action(['RIGHT'] if (15+7*slot-cursor_col(current_frame))%50<25 else ['LEFT'])
    start=glyph(current_frame,52,15+7*slot)
    seq=[start]
    for i in range(12):
        action(['UP']); g=glyph(current_frame,52,15+7*slot); seq.append(g)
        if g==start: break
    cycles[slot]=[black(g) for g in seq[:-1]]
def cells(g): return {(r,c) for r in range(5) for c in range(5) if g[r][c]=='#'}
for i in range(5):
    B=cells(blue[i])
    scores=[]
    for j,v in enumerate(cycles[i]):
        V=cells(v)
        scores.append((len(B&V),len(B-V),len(V-B),j))
    scores.sort(reverse=True)
    print('slot',i,'top overlaps (inter, blue-only, var-only, idx):',scores[:3])
    # containment checks
    cont=[j for j,v in enumerate(cycles[i]) if B<=cells(v)]
    cont2=[j for j,v in enumerate(cycles[i]) if cells(v)<=B]
    print('   blue subset of var:',cont,' var subset of blue:',cont2)
result={'ok':True}
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
